newsitem.title: USA: LPC - CIBC, Scotia lend Toronto Sun buyout $180 mln.
newsitem.headline: LPC - CIBC, Scotia lend Toronto Sun buyout $180 mln.

text.p: NEW YORK, Aug 29 (LPC) - CIBC Wood Gundy and Bank of Nova Scotia will syndicate a $180 million loan to fund in part a management buyout of Toronto Sun Publishing Corp, banking sources said.

The deal is split between a $15 million 364-day operating facility and a $165 million seven-year term loan, a banker said. Only the term loan, which will be fully drawn at closing of the management buyout, will be syndicated, sources said.
The buyout has been estimated to total $411 million, market sources said.
Toronto Sun Publishing owns several Canadian newspapers and a majority interest in The Financial Post.
Shareholders of the newspaper concern will vote on the buyout plan, which would pay $16 per share, on September 24, bankers said.
